D1.rationale: Structured record of every tool call on the battery (name, args, result), including the failed T2 file_write and its recovery; no coverage assertion (not 3); entries carry no timestamps.

D2.rationale: No signatures on records and no documented deterministic-replay or signed-record verification story; nothing for a third party to check beyond re-running.

D3.rationale: Order is message-list order only; no sequence numbers or timestamps bound to entries, no linkage.

D4.rationale: Entries carry per-message random ids and tool_call_id linkage only; no stable run/agent identifier bound to each entry.

D5.rationale: Redaction mechanism exists in pinned source (langchain_v1 PIIMiddleware + RedactionRule) but was not exercised in the run; the fixture secret sits in cleartext x2 in the record.
